_doc: jl10 indent-context parity (fixes a-d + i): one synthetic screen for vox/option_format.indent_context. vox/option_format.py --selftest must build exactly `options` (format v2i) and `options_v2` (plain v2, no indent). The indented RecyclerView (L06/L07 parents + indented children) gains parent-row context. A generic-label parent ('more') must be SKIPPED (c), so 'Hidden child' gets no context. A 2-column grid (A/B and C/D share a row at different lefts, under a header 'Section') must get NO context (i). A FloatingActionButton 'Add' (role 'item') and the button bar (role 'button') must never take a parent (a). Node keys as in app/src/test/resources/target_format_parity.json: cls, id, text, desc, b = [left, top, right, bottom], click, focus, selected, scroll, rows, kids.
